service.description: MQTT 5 (brokerUri mqtt:// or mqtts://, or the legacy paho-mqtt5:?brokerUrl=...). DrtRead waits for one message per item topic; DrtWrite publishes each item to its topic (DeviceRequestItem.query, else DeviceRequest.query) with QoS 1 and succeeds on the PUBACK, or, without items, publishes the payload parameter as JSON on DeviceRequest.query; DrtSubscribe, DrtEvent and DrtCyclic subscribe and store what arrives through InboundServices.store#Samples; DrtUnsubscribe stops the subscription of parentRequestName. Set as DeviceRequest.runServiceName; called by moqui.device.DeviceServices.run#DeviceRequest. A request whose endpoint is another protocol is an error.
